abyssalfin.subjekt: a slender deep-sea merman with a long finned eel-like tail instead of legs, dark teal and electric-blue skin with glowing cyan bioluminescent stripes, translucent ragged fins along the arms and spine, webbed clawed hands, large pale glowing eyes, no armor or clothing
abyssalfin.angriff: whips its long finned tail forward and lashes out with both glowing clawed hands, a burst of cyan water spray around the strike, then returns to the starting pose

chyros.subjekt: a giant armored hermit crab, dark rust-red segmented crab body on eight jointed legs with two massive heavy pincer claws, carrying a huge spiral stone shell carved with glowing teal runes on its back, small black stalk eyes
chyros.angriff: rears up and slams both massive pincer claws down in a crushing double strike, cracking the ground with teal rune sparks, then settles back onto its legs
chyros.tod: is struck down hard, its legs buckle, it topples over sideways and flips onto its back with the spiral shell underneath, claws and legs curled up limp in the air, stops moving and lies dead

nekira.subjekt: an undead skeletal cat-creature standing upright on two legs, bleached bone skull with pointed feline ears and empty black eye sockets, exposed ribcage, long bony whip-like tail, tattered strips of grey fur and dry skin, long bony clawed hands
nekira.angriff: pounces forward and slashes with its long bony claws in a frenzied double swipe, tail lashing, then springs back to the starting pose

terratron.subjekt: a colossal ancient tortoise construct on four thick stone legs, cracked grey stone shell plates with mossy green bushes and a small tree growing on top, weathered rocky skin, heavy wrinkled reptile head, slow massive stance
terratron.angriff: rears up on its hind legs and slams its massive front legs and stone shell down in a ground-shaking stomp, dust and small rocks flying, then settles back down
terratron.tod: is struck down hard, rocks and lurches, topples over and flips onto its back with the stone shell on the ground, all four legs and head dangling limp in the air, stops moving and lies dead

elyon.subjekt: a holy angelic knight in full golden-bronze plate armor with a closed great helm, a glowing golden halo floating above the helmet, two large white feathered wings spread from the back, a long two-handed greatsword, a flowing tattered white cloak
elyon.angriff: raises the greatsword overhead with both hands and brings it down in a powerful vertical slash with a flash of golden light, wings flaring, then returns to a guard stance
